name: Meribah-kadesh
line: Meribah-kadesh was a watering place in the Wilderness of Zin where Moses and Aaron failed to honor God as holy, and Ezekiel's vision names it on the southern border.

moments.title: Moses and Aaron break faith
moments.text: At the waters of Meribah-kadesh, God says Moses and Aaron broke faith with Him by failing to treat Him as holy in front of the Israelites. Because of this, Moses would see the land from a distance but not enter it.

moments.title: The southern border in Ezekiel's vision
moments.text: In Ezekiel's vision, the southern border of the land runs from Tamar to the waters of Meribath-kadesh, then along the Brook of Egypt to the Great Sea.

moments.title: The southern edge of Gad
moments.text: Gad's portion has its southern border running from Tamar to the waters of Meribath-kadesh, then along the Brook of Egypt and out to the Great Sea.
